answer.line: 2 + 7 = 9 equal parts of 4 miles each. The shorter leg is 2 parts: 8 miles.

steps: Add the ratio terms first: 2 + 7 = 9 equal parts make the whole route.
Take the parts you need. The shorter leg is 2 parts: 2 x 4 = 8. Check: 8 + 28 = 36.

choices.note: 4 miles is a single part. The shorter leg is two parts, so double it.
9 is how many parts the route splits into, not miles. Each part is worth 4 miles.
Half of 36 is 18, an even split. A 2 to 7 ratio gives the drivers very different legs.
28 is the longer leg, 7 parts of 4. The stem asks for the shorter one.

visual.alt: One bar for the 36-mile route cut into 9 equal cells of 4 miles. The first 2 cells, the 8-mile shorter leg, are outlined; the other 7 cells make the 28-mile leg. A dashed mark at 18 shows where an even split would fall.
visual.caption: Count the cells: 2 of the 9 equal parts are the shorter leg.
